name: wika-studio
description: WIKA Studio — consola web y BFF

scripts.dev: npm run dev:bff & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wika-studio/wika-client && npm run build -w @wika-studio/bff && npm run build -w @wika-studio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wika-studio/wika-client && npm run typecheck -w @wika-studio/bff && npm run typecheck -w @wika-studio/web
